summary: Completed comprehensive testing of AudioForge authentication integration with Emergent Google Auth. All authentication features working correctly including Sign in to Sync button, guest mode messaging, and cross-device recording sync functionality. Backend auth endpoints return proper 401 responses for unauthenticated users. All existing features (EQ, presets, visualizer, recording) remain fully functional.

Backend auth endpoints - POST /api/auth/logout works without session
Backend auth endpoints - POST /api/auth/session validates session_id properly
Backend recordings API works for guest users (creates recordings without user_id)
Frontend Sign in to Sync button visible in header and clickable
Frontend login redirect to auth.emergentagent.com initiated successfully
Guest mode message 'recordings local only' displayed in Recording section
Save to Cloud toggle present and functional
All existing EQ controls working (5 bands, -12dB to +12dB range)
EQ sliders respond to user input correctly
Preset functionality working (Voice Clarity, Flat, Distant Audio)
Preset loading changes EQ values correctly
Visualizer tabs functional (Wave, Spectrum, Both)
Advanced filters section present (Highpass, Lowpass toggles)
Master gain slider working (1.0x default, adjustable)
Recording controls interface functional
Recording timer display working (00:00.0 format)
Output format selector present (WebM/Opus recommended)
Notes field for recordings available
Record button enabled and clickable
All backend CRUD operations (25/25 tests passed)
Cross-device sync architecture properly implemented
